subject: THZ1/THZ2 object type $18 and the act-clear chain

evidence_classes.DECODED DATA: ROM tables/records decoded by a parser
evidence_classes.BYTE-VERIFIED ASSEMBLY: routine bytes compared literally and disassembled by hand
evidence_classes.SOURCE-TRACED BEHAVIOR: behavior read from the disassembly, not executed
evidence_classes.CONTROLLED ROUTINE RESULT: original routine executed on a Z80 core with explicit RAM
evidence_classes.EMULATED ORIGINAL FRAME: whole original game run in the approximate SMS harness

chain: placement creator $80EB (bank $1C) writes type $18 into a slot, state 0
scheduler $5DF1: type < $26 -> map bank $0C, CALL $64FA (animation engine), CALL $5E91 (callback), then $61E1
animation engine: state table = word at $65BA + (type-1)*2; state script = word at table + 2*state
script record (duration, frame, callback word) sets +$0C/+$0D; $5E91 jumps to the callback each update

state_machine.effect: +$03 bit 7 set (overlap ignores the player's D503 bit-6 gate); +$34 = +$35 = 0; script requests state 1
waits until +$04 bit 6 is clear (object on-screen per $61E1), then requests state 2
dynamic art selector $D3B3 = $12 (sign art); player requested state $12 becomes $0E; script requests state 3
frame 1 (+$2C = 12, +$2D = 42). Each update: gate (player speed != 0 or requested state $18); left camera lock $0353; overlap $033B; on contact: timer stop, hop
spin animation (frames 1..5, duration 2) with sound $F8 once, $AA every 3 records; hop up at -4 px/update, gravity $10/256, lands at the saved Y
FF 01 $AA47 spawns the type-$19 child once, sound $AB, frame 1 held forever (no further transition)
retouch spin: 4 loops of frames 1..5, then callback $A8FA (prize roll again)

prize_tables.selection: LD A,($D297); INC A; RRCA; carry -> table at $A919, no carry -> table at $A962 (zone parity, NOT act)
prize_tables.class_rule: class = 3 - (index_of_first_match // 16) where index is the CPIR position (0..63) of the BCD ring count $D29A; no match = $FF

THZ3 (act index 2) has no type $18: its completion goes through type $50, studied in docs/object-50.md

boundary_grid.formula: contact = |dx| <= (playerExtX + 12) and -42 <= dy <= playerExtY, dx = playerX - signX, dy = playerY - signY

left_lock_while_waiting.rule: state 3 runs $0353 every update only when the gate passes (moving or requested state $18)

hop_trace_thz1.model: Y velocity starts at $FC00 (+$19 = $FC, +$18 unchanged), += $10 per update (clamp $0600), Y += velocity; landing when Y >= saved Y (+$3C/+$3D)

lifetime.type_writes_inside_sign_callbacks: none: no callback in $A867..$AA47 or $AA87..$AB9F writes (IX+0)

prizes.evidence: CONTROLLED ROUTINE RESULT (original $A8FA on the THZ zone-0 table)

child_19.note: the player's floor bit $D522.1 was withheld until update 400 to show that state 4 waits for it

child_19_position.rule: init: X = cameraX + $104, Y = cameraY($D176) + $50; state 1 subtracts 8 from X each update until X <= cameraX + $85

bonus_value.note: L = (rings - $11) in BCD + time-bonus low byte (always 0); the high byte is the time-bonus table entry. No borrow is propagated into H. A zero result is replaced by $0777 (state 3 of the child, $AB4B..$AB4F).

player_state_20.velocity_rule: v = 0 if v < 0; if high byte < 6: v += $10; then position += v (vector $0338)
player_state_20.flag_rule: let d = playerX - cameraX (16-bit); if d <= $F8 keep running; else if d <= $120 keep running; else velocity = 0 and D293 |= $20 when D298 < 2, D293 |= $10 otherwise. d > $120 means d >= $121 (negative d counts as huge)

level_complete_setter.writes: only $D502 (requested player state) and $DE04 (sound request); no timer, control-lock or progression write

timer.rule: no change while $D2BE = 0; otherwise $D2C2 += 1 per frame and at 60 the BCD time word $D2BF (seconds, minutes) advances
